:::{#exm-model-family}
#### Polynomials of degree at most $\polydeg$

The polynomials of degree at most $\polydeg$ form a [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$:
each polynomial maps a [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$ to a prediction,
and the members differ in their coefficients.

:::
